card.one_liner: 항공권 변경 수수료 예외, 날씨·질병 사유 처리, 부분 취소에서 왕복을 지키는 법.

rules.text: Change fees follow the fare rules of the ticket; the agency cannot waive the airline's fee.
A name correction of up to 3 characters is free within 24 hours of booking.
A round trip is changed, never cancelled, when only the return is dropped.
No-show tickets are refunded for taxes only, unless the fare rule says otherwise.

exceptions.text: Weather waivers apply only when the airline publishes one; a typhoon warning alone is not enough, and the waiver window is usually 72 hours.
Illness waivers require a medical certificate dated before departure; a certificate dated after departure is refused by every carrier.
A schedule change over 2 hours gives a free change or full refund even on a non-refundable fare.
Group bookings of 10 or more can change one name free up to 7 days before departure.

judgment_calls.text: If the airline has not published a weather waiver but the forecast is a warning, hold the change request for 24 hours before charging; waivers are often published late.
When a customer asks to cancel only the return, price the one-way change first; it is usually cheaper than forfeiting the outbound.
A no-show caused by an airline-side check-in failure, with a screenshot, is refunded in full by most carriers within 30 days.

common_mistakes.text: Promising a weather waiver before the airline publishes it.
Cancelling the whole round trip to drop a return.
Accepting a medical certificate dated after departure.

never_do.text: Never process an illness waiver with a certificate dated after departure; refuse and explain the date rule.
Never cancel a round trip to drop a return.
Never charge a change fee before checking for a published waiver or a schedule change.
